players.name: Justin Herbert
players.note: He entered the concussion protocol after the Nov. 22 loss to the Jets, in which he was sacked six times. He finished the game with 131 passing yards, 2 TD and a rushing TD, but his Week 12 status vs. New England is in doubt.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: He went 26-of-38 for 235 yards, 0 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22 vs. San Francisco, and Carson Wentz threw 5 late passes. Kyler Murray (hamstring) is targeting a Week 12 return vs. Atlanta on Nov. 29, which would likely end Cousins' run as starter.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He missed Week 11 with a Grade 2 hamstring strain, but Minnesota is still targeting a return Nov. 29 vs. Atlanta. Kevin O'Connell calls him week-to-week, and Kirk Cousins had only 235 yards and 0 TD while filling in on Nov. 22.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: NFL.com's Nov. 20 roundup reported that he has a fractured fibula, suffered Nov. 15 in Munich. He is expected to miss significant time, and Tommy DeVito is set to start when the Patriots return from their bye on Nov. 29.

players.name: Tommy DeVito
players.note: He remains New England's starter with Drake Maye (fractured fibula) out after the Week 11 bye. His first start comes Nov. 29, and he went 12-of-24 for 81 yards in relief Nov. 15.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: He went 18-of-38 for 173 yards and 1 TD with 33 rushing yards on Nov. 22 (14.2 PPR points). Jameis Winston is handling goal-line snaps, and Winston scored a rushing TD Sunday, which caps McCarthy's upside.

players.name: Jameis Winston
players.note: He is getting goal-line packages for the Giants and ran 3 times for 5 yards and a TD on Nov. 22. He has TD vulture value in deep superflex leagues but is not starting at QB.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.note: He went 12-of-33 for 102 yards, 0 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22 (about 4 PPR points). He stays Miami's starter only because Malik Willis is on IR, and Willis can't return before Week 14.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: In his second start on Nov. 22 vs. Pittsburgh he went 11-of-21 for 141 yards with no TDs (6.3 PPR points). He remains the Eagles' starter with Jalen Hurts on IR, but the production makes him hard to trust.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: He sat out Nov. 22 with back spasms, and Josh Johnson went 31 attempts for 155 yards and 1 TD in his place. No Week 12 update had come out as of Nov. 23.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: Indianapolis released him Nov. 20 after a 12-of-27, 144-yard, 1-INT outing at Houston on Nov. 19. He becomes a free agent Monday afternoon (Nov. 23) if unclaimed, and he has no starting role.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: He went 24-of-37 for 276 yards, 1 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22 and remains Baltimore's starter with Lamar Jackson on IR.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Seattle had its bye in Week 11. Mike Macdonald is "really optimistic" Darnold (quad, ribs) starts Nov. 29 vs. the 49ers and says he is QB1 when healthy.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: Seattle had its bye in Week 11. Sam Darnold is expected back Nov. 29 vs. San Francisco, which would send Lock back to the bench.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR and is expected to miss the rest of 2026. Joe Milton has started, and he managed only 141 yards on Nov. 22.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after right-thumb surgery and is likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett is starting and threw for 276 yards on Nov. 22.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR after knee surgery and is expected to miss the rest of the regular season. J.J. McCarthy is starting, with Jameis Winston taking goal-line snaps.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: He has been on IR since Nov. 10 (groin/core muscle) and is eligible to return in Week 14. Kyle McCord struggled in his place on Nov. 22 (102 yards), so Willis should reclaim the job once healthy.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 4:51 PM PT Nov 23. Earlier: Tuten (left ankle/foot) limped off in the fourth quarter of the Nov. 22 game vs. the Giants and did not return, after 10 carries for 33 yards and 3 catches for 20. He had been playing through a high ankle sprain, no imaging results have been reported, and Sleeper lists him questionable.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Rodriguez would be Jacksonville's lead back if Bhayshul Tuten misses time after limping off Nov. 22 vs. the Giants. Rodriguez had 4 carries for 28 yards and a 13-yard catch in that game.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley left the Nov. 22 win over Pittsburgh with a left arm injury after 17 carries for 75 yards and a 38-yard TD, and Will Shipley played the final 13 snaps. Barkley says he expects to play Thursday vs. Dallas but doesn't think he'll be 100% again this season.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Henry was briefly checked for a concussion Nov. 22 vs. Carolina, but he was cleared and is not in the protocol, per PFT. He finished with 13 carries for 94 yards and a TD plus 4 catches for 17 yards.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara had just 1 carry for 1 yard in the Nov. 22 loss, salvaged by a 1-yard TD catch, while Travis Etienne Jr. handled 14 carries. He looks like a change-of-pace back now.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Etienne led the Saints backfield on Nov. 22 with 14 carries for 76 yards, while Alvin Kamara got only 1 carry. He looks like New Orleans' clear early-down back.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Walker (groin) sat out again Nov. 22 vs. Arizona, and Emmett Johnson ran for 105 yards and a TD on 23 carries in his place. Kansas City has no rush to bring Walker back, and Johnson's play threatens his workload once he returns.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: Johnson started again for injured Kenneth Walker III on Nov. 22 vs. Arizona: 23 carries for 105 yards and a TD plus 4 catches for 38 yards. It's his second straight big game, and he has a strong case to keep a large role.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Green Bay listed Jacobs (finger surgery) as limited in practice on Nov. 22, keeping him in contention to return Wednesday vs. the Rams. Sleeper still lists him as out.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Josh Jacobs was limited in practice Nov. 22 and is trending toward returning Wednesday vs. the Rams, which would likely push Johnson back into a backup role.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Williams (toe) was again listed as limited on the Nov. 22 Rams-Packers injury report ahead of Wednesday's game. He remains in a near-even timeshare with Blake Corum.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman dominated Denver's backfield Nov. 22 with 24 carries for 111 yards and 3 TDs plus 4 catches for 18 yards, while J.K. Dobbins got 1 carry. He is firmly the lead back.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins got just 1 carry for 0 yards on Nov. 22 while Jonah Coleman took 24, so his offensive role has all but disappeared.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.note: Hubbard handled a workhorse load Nov. 22 vs. Baltimore: 27 carries for 120 yards and 2 TDs, with Trevor Etienne getting 6 carries. Jonathon Brooks remains on IR.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: Sleeper now lists McGowan out with a hamstring injury after he played only 9 of 50 snaps on TNF Nov. 19, with 3 carries for 7 yards. DJ Giddens also got backup work behind Jonathan Taylor.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was on injured reserve) as of 4:51 PM PT Nov 23. Earlier: Croskey-Merritt (groin) was designated to return from IR Nov. 17 and is expected back for tonight's Nov. 23 MNF game vs. Cincinnati. Sleeper still showed him on IR Monday morning, so check that he's active; a split with Rachaad White is likely.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 4:51 PM PT Nov 23. Earlier: White (heel) is questionable for tonight's Nov. 23 MNF game vs. Cincinnati after limited practices, though he's expected to play. Jacory Croskey-Merritt's likely return from IR points to a split backfield.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers (ankle/quad) was out for the Raiders' Week 11 game at Denver on Nov 22 and has no Week 11 stats. Michael Mayer filled in and caught 1 of 4 targets for 4 yards.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Kincaid (thumb) missed the Bills' Week 11 game on Nov 22 and is still listed out on Sleeper. Dawson Knox was expected to lead the Bills TE room without him.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.note: Johnson played through a questionable tag (hamstring) in Week 11 on Nov 22 but drew only 1 target and had no catches. He is still listed questionable on Sleeper.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (ankle) is still on IR after the Rams' Week 11 bye. Sean McVay said on Nov 14 that he would miss 'another couple weeks', so Week 12 is the earliest he could realistically return.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: The Patriots were idle in Week 11, and Drake Maye (fractured fibula per NFL.com, Nov 15) is expected to miss significant time. That leaves Tommy DeVito at QB, which lowers Henry's ceiling for the rest of the season.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Kelce caught 6 of 7 targets for 74 yards and 2 TDs in Week 11 on Nov 22. Jared Wiley is on IR, so Kelce's role is secure after he played limited snaps in Week 10.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson returned from his wrist/chest injury in Week 11 on Nov 22 and caught 6 of 7 targets for 55 yards. With Jordan Addison out after thumb surgery, his target share should stay strong.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (hamstring, hurt Nov 15) was still listed out on Sleeper as of Nov 23, and no MRI result or timeline has been reported. New England had its bye in Week 11, so Week 12 at the Chargers is the earliest he could return.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (hamstring) was ruled out and did not play in Week 11 vs. the Jets on Nov 22. That makes four straight missed games, and he is still listed out as of Nov 23.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: Atlanta was on bye in Week 11, but Sleeper still lists London questionable (head) as of Nov 23. His next game is Week 12 at Minnesota, so watch this week's practice reports.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: San Francisco's two-week roster exemption for Aiyuk expires Nov 23, and reports expect the 49ers to release him rather than add him to the 53-man roster. Kyle Shanahan has said the reinstatement 'means absolutely nothing to our team.'

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Lane was active in Week 11 on Nov 22 but did not record a catch or a target in the Sleeper box score. A week earlier he drew 11 targets vs. the Chargers, so his role looks volatile.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt was a coach's-decision inactive again in Week 11 on Nov 22, his second straight healthy scratch. He has no clear path to playing time without an injury in Baltimore's receiver room.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Bernard drew 10 targets (6-40) at Philadelphia on Nov 22, a week after getting only 3 targets. DK Metcalf was limited to 1 catch for 2 yards in the same game.

players.name: DK Metcalf
players.note: Metcalf was questionable entering Week 11, then played and caught 1 of 4 targets for 2 yards at Philadelphia on Nov 22. Rookie Germie Bernard drew 10 targets in that game.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Douglas played through a shoulder injury vs. Buffalo on Nov 22 and led Miami with 10 targets (2-30). Chris Bell's return did not cut into his volume.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Bell played through a chest injury vs. Buffalo on Nov 22 and caught 1 of 4 targets for 8 yards. Sleeper still lists him questionable (chest) as of Nov 23.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith returned from a three-game hamstring absence vs. Pittsburgh on Nov 22 and drew 12 targets (5-41). That volume confirms his full role is back.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) returned in Week 11 at Dallas on Nov 22 and caught 2 of 5 targets for 58 yards and a TD. He is no longer on the injury report.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams (hamstring surgery) remains on IR through the Rams' Week 11 bye. He is targeting a return around Weeks 12-13, and no activation had been reported as of Nov 23.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce (heel) has been on IR since Week 3 and did not play in Week 11. On Nov 11, Shane Steichen said he was unsure whether Pierce will return in 2026.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison (thumb surgery) missed Week 11, a 35-10 loss to San Francisco on Nov 22. He is expected to miss multiple weeks, and the Vikings have said he won't go on IR.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua had MCL surgery the week of Nov 17, and McVay effectively ruled him out for the rest of the regular season. He is also serving a three-game suspension.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) has missed two straight games and has not practiced since before Week 9. Houston is on bye, so his earliest return is Nov 29 vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Cooper (ankle/hip) sat out the Jets' 27-24 win over the Chargers on Nov 22. It was his third ankle injury this year, and he could miss multiple weeks.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring, Week 8) had not been reported practicing as of Nov 20. Atlanta's Week 11 bye gives him extra time to recover.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) remains on IR through New England's Week 11 bye, and no return date has been reported.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season after fracturing his neck on Nov 8 vs. Seattle.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin is out for the 2026 season after tearing his left patellar tendon on Oct 19.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot) stayed on IR and missed Week 11 at Philadelphia on Nov 22. His next chance to be activated is Week 12 vs. Denver.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: As of Nov 22, Hill is still unsigned and has not been medically cleared from his knee injury. Agent Drew Rosenhaus has given no return date, and suitors are reportedly waiting for clearance before making offers.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey returned from a two-game back absence on Nov 22 vs. the Jets and played a full-time role, catching 5 of 8 targets for 37 yards and two fourth-quarter TDs. Justin Herbert entered the concussion protocol after the game, which clouds the Week 12 outlook vs. New England.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: With McConkey back full-time on Nov 22, Harris fell to 2 catches for 28 yards on 2 targets vs. the Jets. Justin Herbert also entered the concussion protocol after the game.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans returned from Achilles tendinitis on Nov 22 vs. Minnesota after missing three games and caught 6 of 7 targets for 109 yards and a TD in the 35-10 win.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: With Mike Evans back on Nov 22, Allen was held to 3 catches for 38 yards on 4 targets vs. Minnesota, so his fill-in role is shrinking.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson was off the injury report (chest) but was held to 1 catch for 6 yards on 2 targets at Chicago on Nov 22. Kellen Moore took the blame for personnel sequencing that kept him off the field for an extended stretch. Chris Olave drew 15 targets.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: With DeVonta Smith back on Nov 22 (12 targets), Lemon managed 1 catch for 3 yards on 3 targets vs. Pittsburgh, so his fill-in WR1 volume is gone.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.note: Jaylen Waddle returned from his concussion on Nov 22 and drew 6 targets, while Bryant slipped to 3 catches for 32 yards on 4 targets vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson played in his first game back from IR (finger) on Nov 22 at Philadelphia, catching 3 of 6 targets for 43 yards. He keeps a larger role while Pittman remains on IR.

players.name: Skyler Bell
players.note: Bell was a coach's-decision inactive for Week 11 vs. Miami on Nov 22, so he is outside Buffalo's receiver rotation for now.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: Washington drew a huge 17 targets at the Giants on Nov 22, catching 8 for 103 yards, which cements his lead-receiver role in Jacksonville's injury-thinned group.

players.name: Ted Hurst III
players.note: Hurst caught 5 of 7 targets for 56 yards and two TDs in Week 11 (Nov 22). He out-targeted Emeka Egbuka (5) in a growing role.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ankle) as of 4:51 PM PT Nov 23.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (shin) as of 4:51 PM PT Nov 23.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Jordan James
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:45 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: James (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game vs. Minnesota in Mexico City after limited practices Thursday and Friday (Nov. 19-20). His recent role has been mostly kick returns.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Drew Allar
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Geno Smith
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: He was limited in practice on Wednesday and Thursday (Nov. 18-19) with a left-ankle injury. He says he plans to play, and the Jets believe he can start Sunday at the Chargers.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: He is officially questionable (foot, right thumb) for Sunday's Nov. 22 game at Detroit after limited practices Thursday and Friday. Ian Rapoport reports he will play, and Tom Pelissero says he is good to go barring a setback.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (knee) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Meyers was limited with an ankle injury Nov 18; he has played through the injury for several weeks. Jacksonville faces the Giants Sunday.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Waddle (concussion) practiced fully Nov 18, and reports had him at full again Thursday, Nov 19. He is trending toward playing Nov 22 vs. Las Vegas, pending formal clearance from the protocol.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him on injured reserve (ankle) as of 3:17 PM PT Nov 21.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (back) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.
